error_category_mapping.diagnostic_sentence: If 5 is combined with the x terms, the next link is recognising like terms. Expanding quadratics depends on collecting only terms with the same variable power.

hint_ladder.title: Like x terms
hint_ladder.prompt: Only terms with the same letter and power can be combined. Here, 6x and -2x are like terms.

hint_ladder.title: Combine coefficients
hint_ladder.prompt: Keep the x, and combine the signed coefficients: 6 and -2.

hint_ladder.title: Constant stays
hint_ladder.prompt: A common slip is mixing the 5 into the x terms. The constant is unlike the x terms and stays separate.

hint_ladder.title: Like-term routine
hint_ladder.prompt: Group matching variable parts, add their coefficients, and leave unlike terms alone. Apply that here; do not copy.

expected_solution_steps.diagnostic_sentence: This repair focuses on combining the x coefficients while keeping the constant term separate.
